messages.author: c03adc32d52e7037
messages.subject: Error library(camtrapR)
parts:
Hello,
I have problems loading the library in R-studio, when I call the >library(camtrapR)
I get this message back:

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘camtrapR’ in loadNamespace (j <- i [[1L]], c (lib.loc, .libPaths ()), versionCheck = vI [[j]]):
 there is no package called ‘taxize’

Does anyone know anything about this error?
Thank you!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error library(camtrapR)
parts:
Dear Nubia,
the error message means that a package camtrapR needs (taxize) is not available on that computer.
You could installing camtrapR the package again.

install.packages("camtrapR")

Normally other packages that camtrapR depends on should be installed automatically (that is the default of install.packages)
If it doesn't, install the missing package with 

install.packages("taxize")

Best,
Jürgen
